source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex linkage (PDF 105).

blocks.text: Sex chromosomes par maujood alleles se qaboo hone wali khasiyatein sex-linked khasiyatein hain, aur is amal ko sex linkage kehte hain. Sex-linked khasiyatein asal mein X-linked hain kyunke Y chromosome par aam taur par taqreeban koi kaam ka gene nahi hota; isi liye sex-linked khasiyaton ki nisbat nar aur maada mein mukhtalif hoti hai.
Bohat kam khasiyaton ke alleles X aur Y dono par hote hain. Aisi khasiyatein nar aur maada mein barabar hoti hain aur X-Y-linked ya pseudo-autosomal khasiyatein kehlati hain.

blocks.prompt: Pseudo-autosomal khasiyatein dono jinson mein barabar kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Un ke alleles X aur Y dono par hain, is liye nar aur maada dono do copies rakhte hain, autosome ki tarah.

items: Sex-linked ka matlab aam taur par X-linked.
X aur Y dono par alleles: X-Y-linked (pseudo-autosomal) khasiyatein.
